ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Every approval request, receipt reminder, payment alert, and card notification Ramp sends has to reach the right person, on the right channel, at the right time. When it does, finance teams close faster and employees spend less time chasing tasks. When it doesn't, a missed message can mean a stalled approval, a late payment, or a flood of notifications nobody asked for.



Ramp's Communications Platform team builds the shared system that every product team uses to reach customers. It handles transactional messages across email, SMS, push, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and WhatsApp, including templating, delivery, retries, digesting, user preferences, and delivery monitoring. The team also supports the conversational experiences that let customers work with Ramp directly from the channels they already use.



We're looking for a backend engineer to own a core part of that platform. You'll take responsibility for an area such as message delivery and channel integrations, communication preferences, or platform reliability and scale, set its technical direction within the team, and keep it correct and dependable as message volume and the number of teams building on it grow. You'll work closely with product, design, and engineering partners across Ramp to make communications faster, more reliable, and easier for every team to build on.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the design and evolution of a core part of Ramp's communications platform, from technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration

 - Build and extend integrations with messaging channels and delivery providers, including email, SMS, push, and workplace chat tools such as Slack and Microsoft Teams

 - Design delivery workflows that are idempotent, retry safely, and confirm successful delivery, so customers reliably get the messages they need without duplicate sends

 - Build communication preferences and controls that let users and administrators decide what they receive and where

 - Make the platform simple and safe for other Ramp engineers to build on, with clear abstractions, strong defaults, and good developer tooling

 - Improve the reliability, performance, and observability of the platform as message volume grows

 - Drive technical direction for your area and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows

 - A track record of owning a system or product area end to end and shaping its technical direction over time

 - Strong system design judgment, especially around reliability, idempotency, and correctness in high-volume distributed systems

 - Product sense: you care about the experience of the people receiving each message, not just the ticket, and you balance speed with quality

 - Clear communication and a collaborative approach to technical decisions across product, design, and engineering
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building notification, messaging, or communications platforms

 - Experience integrating with messaging providers or channel APIs, such as Twilio, SendGrid, Slack, Microsoft Teams, or WhatsApp

 - Experience building internal platforms or shared services used by many engineering teams

 - Experience scaling high-volume, event-driven, or queue-based systems

**Job Title: Embedded Software Engineer**
**Job Description**
This role focuses on designing, developing, and debugging embedded software systems that directly interface with sensors, motor controllers, actuators, and hardware platforms used in safety-critical robotics applications. You will support the development and evolution of the Autonomy Test Cube (ATC) and related autonomous robotics platforms, contributing to multiple autonomy and robotics programs that validate perception and safety systems for next-generation robotic platforms. The position is ideal for an embedded software engineer who enjoys writing code daily, working close to hardware, and solving complex hardwaresoftware integration challenges in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded software applications in C and C++ for robotics and autonomous systems.
* Develop robust software interfaces for hardware components including sensors, motor controllers, actuators, servo motors, PLCs, and embedded processing platforms.
* Read and interpret hardware datasheets, device drivers, and technical specifications to implement and integrate new functionality into embedded systems.
* Debug software across multiple layers of the system, from low-level hardware interfaces and drivers to application-level services and control logic.
* Support integration activities with robotics, controls, mechanical, automation, and test engineering teams to ensure seamless system operation.
* Participate in the migration of embedded applications across different hardware platforms and operating environments, including Linux-based and RTOS systems.
* Contribute to software architecture discussions, perform code reviews, and help drive technical decision-making for embedded and robotics software solutions.
* Develop and maintain clear technical documentation, design specifications, and test procedures for embedded software and system interfaces.
* Troubleshoot issues in both lab and field-test environments, including multi-axis motion systems, gantries, and autonomous robotic platforms.
* Support the Autonomy Test Cube (ATC), a 12x12x12 robotic test environment, by contributing to embedded software that enables validation of perception and autonomy software through a multi-axis gantry system.
* Collaborate closely with the Safety Perception Team to develop and maintain safety-critical software pipelines for autonomous robotic platforms and future-generation systems.
* Work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining strong communication and collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Use version control systems such as Git to manage source code and support modern software development workflows.
* Create and use Python scripts to support automation, testing, tooling, and integration tasks related to embedded and robotics systems.

**Essential Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Strong professional experience developing embedded software in C and C++.
* Experience working with Linux-based embedded systems and familiarity with embedded operating systems.
* Experience with RTOS environments such as FreeRTOS, MicroOS, or similar real-time operating systems.
* Hands-on experience interfacing software with sensors, actuators, motor controllers, servo motors, PLCs, and other embedded peripherals.
* Ability to analyze hardware documentation, datasheets, and technical specifications to implement software drivers and control functionality.
* Strong debugging skills that span both hardware and software boundaries in embedded and robotics systems.
* Experience using version control systems such as Git for source code management.
* Proficiency with Python scripting for automation, tooling, or test support.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced development environment with minimal supervision.
* Comfort working as an embedded software engineer first and foremost, writing code daily and troubleshooting low-level hardwaresoftware integration issues.

**Additional Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience with Rust development or a strong willingness to learn Rust for embedded and robotics applications.
* Knowledge of motor control systems, servo drives, motion control, or robotics platforms.
* Experience with embedded processing platforms such as NVIDIA, Texas Instruments SoCs, ARM-based systems, or similar architectures.
* Familiarity with robotics frameworks such as ROS and ROS2, including robot operating system concepts and tooling.
* Experience working with real-time communication protocols, networking, and distributed systems in embedded or robotics environments.
* Exposure to PLC-based automation systems and industrial controls, including PLC programming and automation workflows.
* Experience supporting safety-critical or mission-critical systems in robotics, automation, or related domains.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern software development practices for embedded software.
* Experience working with multi-axis motion systems, gantries, or autonomous robotic platforms, including integration and troubleshooting.
* Experience designing or implementing graphical user interfaces (GUI) that interact with embedded or robotics systems.

**Work Environment**
You will work within a multidisciplinary Safety Perception Team that focuses on safety-critical software pipelines for autonomous robotic platforms and future-generation systems. The environment centers around the Autonomy Test Cube (ATC), a 12x12x12 robotic test facility that uses a multi-axis gantry system to validate perception and autonomy software for advanced robotics. Day-to-day work involves close collaboration with robotics, controls, mechanical, automation, and test engineers, using Linux-based embedded systems, RTOS environments, PLCs, motor controllers, sensors, and modern software development tools such as Git and CI/CD pipelines. The role blends lab-based development and debugging with hands-on integration and testing in field-like environments, offering a fast-paced, technically challenging setting where continuous learning and problem solving are encouraged.

**Description**
Amazon Ads works with hundreds of thousands of advertisers, each on a different journey — some running their first campaign, others expanding into streaming TV or display, some at risk of slowing down. The Sales AI team builds the machine learning products that tell sales teams where each advertiser is on that journey and what will help them grow. Our segmentation platform models how advertisers mature over time, predicts where each is heading, and identifies the actions most likely to move them forward — shaping how Amazon Ads organizes sales coverage and decides which advertisers receive managed support.
  
  
We're now evolving segmentation from describing where advertisers are to recommending what sellers should do: personalized, interpretable recommendations delivered directly in the tools sellers already use, with a feedback loop that measures which actions actually drive advertiser growth. You'll design and deliver the ML platform and data pipelines that take models from experimentation to production, deliver predictions and recommendations reliably to sales systems at scale, and help move from monthly batch outputs toward on-demand insights — working closely with applied scientists, data scientists, and product partners at the intersection of ML, large-scale data systems, and sales productivity.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and operate the ML platform that takes segmentation models from experimentation to production — including feature ingestion, training, batch inference, and model monitoring
* Deliver model outputs — predictions, scores, and recommendations — reliably to downstream sales systems and partner teams, with clear freshness, versioning, and availability guarantees
* Build scalable, automated data pipelines that bring new advertiser and sales engagement signals into the models quickly, with strong data quality checks
* Design and deliver solutions for well-scoped problems where the technical approach isn't yet defined — such as serving predictions on demand or generating explanations for recommendations
* Partner with applied scientists and data scientists to productionize new models, shorten iteration cycles, and make it easy for scientists to ship without heavy engineering support
* Build the instrumentation that captures how sellers use recommendations and what happens next, so the team can measure impact and improve the models
* Deliver your services end to end — testing, deployment, monitoring, operational excellence, and on-call
* Participate in design and code reviews, holding a high bar for quality, security, and reliability
* Mentor teammates and help onboard new engineers

A day in the life
  
  
Your morning might start with the scientists on your team, reviewing results from a new model experiment and deciding what it takes to get it into production. In the afternoon, you might design a pipeline for new advertiser signals, review a teammate's code, or agree with a partner team on how they'll consume a recommendation dataset. Some days you'll trace a data quality alert to its source and fix it; others you'll prototype on-demand predictions. You'll spend most of your day hands-on in the code, and see your work shape how sellers engage with advertisers.
  
  
**About The Team**
Sales AI is part of Amazon Ads. We're a team of software engineers, applied scientists, data scientists, and product managers who build the machine learning products behind how Amazon Ads understands advertisers and supports them through sales. Our segmentation models already inform how sales coverage is organized, and we're now extending that work into recommendations that sellers use every day. Engineers and scientists here work as one team: we take ideas from experiment to production together, and we judge success by how our work changes seller actions and advertiser growth — not by model metrics alone.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**Description**
Join our Robotics Development and Packaging Innovation Experiences team as a Software Development Engineer and help shape the future of sustainable packaging at Amazon. You'll design and deploy large-scale systems that decide which products get tested, collect and verify the physical attributes of items, and turn that data into packaging decisions that reduce waste, lower our cost to serve, and support Amazon's commitment to the Climate Pledge. Our products and programs are public facing, so you'll have a unique opportunity to shape what customers experience on every order.
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll focus on building intelligent packaging deterministic workflows and large-scale platforms that power our packaging operations worldwide. These systems process hundreds of millions of products every day, across hundreds of fulfillment centers and every customer order. That work drives hundreds of millions of dollars in savings, reduces packaging waste and damage, and puts sustainable packaging choices in front of millions of customers. You'll own the services that decide which products to test, the tools fulfillment center associates and test labs rely on to test, inspect, and escalate packaging issues, and the customer-facing packaging experiences across the product detail page, cart, and checkout, including concealment for items whose packaging could reveal what's inside. You'll participate in code reviews with peers, mentor junior engineers as they grow their skills, and contribute to discussions that shape our technical strategy. Beyond individual contributions, you'll help establish best practices that ensure quality across our infrastructure and production services, which form the backbone of our packaging engines and support our Climate Pledge and sustainability initiatives.
  
  
Your work will shape how millions of packages ship every day, with every decision explainable down to a single product. You will build the source of truth for how Amazon understands the physical world of its products: what they're made of, how they hold up in transit, and how they should ship. You will design systems where every attribute carries its full history, including its source, confidence, and the test or model that produced it, so teams across Amazon can build on it with confidence. You will drive intelligent prioritization that puts testing effort where it creates the most value, and help build a platform where new packaging programs, such as flexible and automated packaging, launch quickly through configuration. We are seeking an engineer who is a true owner: hands-on, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited to define new technology that will be used by Amazon fulfillment and packaging services around the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, test, and deploy item packaging intelligence workflows and platforms that serve our worldwide customer base
* Partner with product leaders, operations, and cross-functional teams to influence packaging roadmap decisions and define technical strategy aligned with sustainability goals
* Build and maintain core infrastructure, production services, and tools that support fulfillment centers, test labs, and field operations
* Deliver customer-facing packaging experiences across the product detail page, cart, and checkout. Make sure eligibility and concealment data shows up accurately, run controlled experiments, and resolve customer-reported issues at the root cause
* Build toward a unified, traceable item attribute store and configurable prioritization that lets new packaging programs launch without new engineering effort
* Drive system architecture decisions and establish best practices that enable code quality, reliability, and scalability across our software systems
* Coach and support junior engineers in their technical growth and help them develop their skills in building large-scale distributed systems

**Description**
Come build the future of data streaming with the Amazon Managed Streaming for Kafka (MSK) team!
  
  
We are seeking builders for our Amazon MSK service, a fully managed service that makes it easy for customers to build and run applications that use Apache Kafka to process streaming data. We are looking for engineers who are enthusiastic about data streaming, and are as passionate about contributing to open source as they are about solving real customers' business needs, at AWS scale.
  
  
As a member of the Amazon MSK team, you will be making contributions to the entire core data plane stack that make up the MSK service, the core Kafka platform, and stand-alone tools that make it easier for Kafka community to operate Kafka better. Upstream compatibility is a core tenet of MSK. Your code changes to the Kafka platform will be released back to open source. As a member of an AWS service that builds on top of a popular open source technology, this is a unique opportunity to work on a team that straddles both worlds – open source and Amazon-internal software. You will design and build new features, make performance improvements, identify and investigate new technologies, prototype solutions, build scalable services, and test and review changes, to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
  
  
The ideal candidate has experience designing large-scale systems supporting millions of transactions per second, enjoys solving complex software problems, and possesses analytical, design and problem-solving skills. Ideally you have an in-depth understanding of streaming data technologies like Amazon Kinesis or Apache Kafka, and experience with open-source data processing frameworks like Apache Spark, Apache Flink, or Apache Storm. Your responsibilities will include collaborating with other engineers to build a large scale AWS service, and work with senior leaders to define your team's roadmap, including identifying design and code changes needed in the underlying open source platforms.
  
  
Learn more about Amazon MSK: - AWS re:Invent 2018: Amazon Managed Streaming for Kafka (Amazon MSK) Launch
  
  

* AWS re:Invent 2020: How Goldman Sachs uses an Amazon MSK backbone for Transaction Banking Platform
* AWS re:Invent 2020: How New Relic is migrating its Apache Kafka cluster to Amazon MSK
* AWS re:Invent 2021: How Coinbase uses Amazon MSK as an event store for applications
* MSK Tiered Storage: Optimize cost and improve Kafka scalability
* AWS re:Invent 2023: How Rivian builds real-time analytics from electric vehicles

**Description**
Amazon Ads works with hundreds of thousands of advertisers, each on a different journey — some running their first campaign, others expanding into streaming TV or display, some at risk of slowing down. The Sales AI team builds the machine learning products that tell sales teams where each advertiser is on that journey and what will help them grow. Our segmentation platform models how advertisers mature over time, predicts where each is heading, and identifies the actions most likely to move them forward — shaping how Amazon Ads organizes sales coverage and decides which advertisers receive managed support.
  
  
We're now evolving segmentation from describing where advertisers are to recommending what sellers should do: personalized, interpretable recommendations delivered directly in the tools sellers already use, with a feedback loop that measures which actions actually drive advertiser growth. You'll design and deliver the ML platform and data pipelines that take models from experimentation to production, deliver predictions and recommendations reliably to sales systems at scale, and help move from monthly batch outputs toward on-demand insights — working closely with applied scientists, data scientists, and product partners at the intersection of ML, large-scale data systems, and sales productivity.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and operate the ML platform that takes segmentation models from experimentation to production — including feature ingestion, training, batch inference, and model monitoring
* Deliver model outputs — predictions, scores, and recommendations — reliably to downstream sales systems and partner teams, with clear freshness, versioning, and availability guarantees
* Build scalable, automated data pipelines that bring new advertiser and sales engagement signals into the models quickly, with strong data quality checks
* Design and deliver solutions for well-scoped problems where the technical approach isn't yet defined — such as serving predictions on demand or generating explanations for recommendations
* Partner with applied scientists and data scientists to productionize new models, shorten iteration cycles, and make it easy for scientists to ship without heavy engineering support
* Build the instrumentation that captures how sellers use recommendations and what happens next, so the team can measure impact and improve the models
* Deliver your services end to end — testing, deployment, monitoring, operational excellence, and on-call
* Participate in design and code reviews, holding a high bar for quality, security, and reliability
* Mentor teammates and help onboard new engineers

A day in the life
  
  
Your morning might start with the scientists on your team, reviewing results from a new model experiment and deciding what it takes to get it into production. In the afternoon, you might design a pipeline for new advertiser signals, review a teammate's code, or agree with a partner team on how they'll consume a recommendation dataset. Some days you'll trace a data quality alert to its source and fix it; others you'll prototype on-demand predictions. You'll spend most of your day hands-on in the code, and see your work shape how sellers engage with advertisers.
  
  
**About The Team**
Sales AI is part of Amazon Ads. We're a team of software engineers, applied scientists, data scientists, and product managers who build the machine learning products behind how Amazon Ads understands advertisers and supports them through sales. Our segmentation models already inform how sales coverage is organized, and we're now extending that work into recommendations that sellers use every day. Engineers and scientists here work as one team: we take ideas from experiment to production together, and we judge success by how our work changes seller actions and advertiser growth — not by model metrics alone.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
Join a team of 10 within Salesforce AI Labs, bringing computer-use AI into production with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Salesforce. We’re building Systems Integration Agent, announced at Dreamforce, which learns how to operate enterprise applications and turns complex workflows into reusable, code-backed automation. Customers are already running workflows in production; now we’re making that success repeatable across more systems and use cases.
  
  
Making computer use dependable raises hard engineering questions. How does an agent know it succeeded? When should it reason, and when should it follow a deterministic path? How should it recover when an application changes or ask for help before making a consequential mistake?
  
  
You’ll help answer those questions in production. Our team works directly with customers, building alongside them and turning discoveries into reusable product capabilities. As a Principal Engineer, you’ll remain hands-on while shaping architecture across our agent and backend systems, owning critical capabilities from design through operation, and helping other engineers deliver them.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
Drive Agent Development & Architecture
  
  

* Design and build systems that learn from demonstrations and combine AI reasoning with deterministic execution to complete workflows reliably.
* Develop recovery and verification capabilities so agents can adapt to changes, confirm outcomes, and recognize when human intervention is needed.
* Build backend services with robust workflow state management, failure handling, and secure access to customer environments.
* Create evaluations and diagnostics that measure task success, expose regressions, and make failures understandable.

Build Directly With Customers
  
  

* Work alongside customers to understand their workflows, prototype solutions, and validate results in their environments.
* Investigate where automation succeeds or fails, then turn those findings into improvements to the core product.
* Help customers move from their first successful workflow toward repeatable, increasingly self-service adoption.
* Partner with forward-deployed engineers and product management to decide which customer needs should shape the roadmap.

Shape Technical Direction & Grow the Team
  
  

* Lead architectural decisions across agent execution, backend services, and workflow state, aligning system boundaries and tradeoffs with other technical leads.
* Evaluate model selection, tool use, and context management against reliability, latency, and cost.
* Raise the engineering bar through hands-on implementation, design reviews, and mentoring; help engineers take on broader ownership and participate in hiring.

**You're Our Person If...**

* You’ve led the architecture and delivery of complex backend systems through deployment, production failures, and subsequent improvements, with impact across multiple components or teams.
* You have hands-on experience shipping and operating LLM-powered systems, and can explain how evaluations and production failures informed your design decisions.
* You can reason through concurrency, persistent state, retries, and partial failures in systems that perform consequential actions.
* You’re proficient in Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* You can turn an unclear customer problem into a bounded technical approach, test it with users, and lead it through production while creating capabilities other engineers can build on.
* You want direct customer engagement to be part of your engineering work, including investigating problems and discussing technical tradeoffs.
* You use AI development tools thoughtfully and take responsibility for the correctness, security, and maintainability of what you ship.

**Even Better If…**

* Agent tool use, code generation, automated recovery, or evaluation frameworks.
* Browser automation, workflow orchestration, or enterprise integrations.
* Building an early-stage product or working in a customer-facing engineering role.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

**The Experience**
Join a team of 10 within Salesforce AI Labs, bringing computer-use AI into production with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Salesforce. We’re building Systems Integration Agent, announced at Dreamforce, which learns how to operate enterprise applications and turns complex workflows into reusable, code-backed automation. Customers are already running workflows in production; now we’re making that success repeatable across more systems and use cases.
  
  
Making computer use dependable raises hard engineering questions. How does an agent know it succeeded? When should it reason, and when should it follow a deterministic path? How should it recover when an application changes or ask for help before making a consequential mistake?
  
  
You’ll help answer those questions in production. Our team works directly with customers, building alongside them and turning discoveries into reusable product capabilities. As a Principal Engineer, you’ll remain hands-on while shaping architecture across our agent and backend systems, owning critical capabilities from design through operation, and helping other engineers deliver them.

Drive Agent Development & Architecture
  
  

* Design and build systems that learn from demonstrations and combine AI reasoning with deterministic execution to complete workflows reliably.

* Build backend services with robust workflow state management, failure handling, and secure access to customer environments.
* Create evaluations and diagnostics that measure task success, expose regressions, and make failures understandable.

Build Directly With Customers
  
  

* Work alongside customers to understand their workflows, prototype solutions, and validate results in their environments.
* Investigate where automation succeeds or fails, then turn those findings into improvements to the core product.
* Help customers move from their first successful workflow toward repeatable, increasingly self-service adoption.
* Partner with forward-deployed engineers and product management to decide which customer needs should shape the roadmap.

Shape Technical Direction & Grow the Team
  
  

* Lead architectural decisions across agent execution, backend services, and workflow state, aligning system boundaries and tradeoffs with other technical leads.
* Evaluate model selection, tool use, and context management against reliability, latency, and cost.
* Raise the engineering bar through hands-on implementation, design reviews, and mentoring; help engineers take on broader ownership and participate in hiring.

In this client-facing technical role, you will develop LLM-powered solutions, build scalable Python services and data pipelines, and integrate AI capabilities into enterprise workflows. Responsible AI & Security: Implement guardrails, data privacy controls, and governance practices that align with client security, model risk management, and regulatory compliance standards.

**Software Developer — Build Your Own Project with an AI Coding Assistant**
**About The Role**
What if you could get paid to work on the project you've been meaning to build — with a state-of-the-art AI coding assistant at your side, completely free of charge?
  
  
We're looking for software developers in the Seattle area to bring their own projects and build them using an AI-powered coding assistant. You write real code on real projects you care about. We learn from your expert judgment on how the assistant performed. You keep full ownership of everything you build.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role designed for developers who want to ship their own work — and get compensated for it.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Fully Remote
* Commitment: Flexible

**What You'll Do**

* Bring a software project you personally own — a side project, a tool, an open-source library, or something you've been meaning to finish
* Build features, fix bugs, refactor code, write docs, or do whatever your project needs — using an AI coding assistant
* At each step, compare two versions of the assistant's response, choose the better one, and write a brief explanation of your reasoning
* Work in your own environment, on your own schedule, with your own tools

**Who You Are**

* A developer with a software project you personally own, stored in a git repository
* Comfortable working in the terminal and with git-based workflows
* Running macOS, Linux, or Windows with WSL2
* Able to write clear, honest evaluations — you'll explain your choices in a few sentences
* Self-motivated and reliable when working independently
* Open-source maintainers are especially welcome

**What's Eligible**

* Software projects that you personally and solely own
* Open-source projects with an approved license
* If your project has other maintainers, mention it in your application — we'll confirm eligibility

**What's Not Eligible**

* Work owned by an employer, client, university, company, or startup
* Projects under NDA
* AI model training or evaluation projects; ML infrastructure
* Security exploit tooling
* Projects that process other people's personal data

**Good to Know**

* Before starting, you'll sign short contributor terms and we'll approve your project
* Transcripts of your coding sessions are used to improve AI models and cannot be withdrawn after submission — this covers sessions only, not the rest of your codebase
* Your ratings and written feedback become part of the project's deliverables
* During sessions: no passwords, API keys, or other people's personal data — and you write your ratings yourself, without AI help

**Why You'll Love This**

* Your project, your code — you keep full ownership of everything, including code the assistant writes for you
* Free AI tokens — your AI usage during sessions is fully covered, no subscription or API bill needed
* Paid to build what you'd build anyway — real compensation for real development work on your own project
* Fully remote and flexible — work from your own computer, on your own schedule
* Shape the future of AI-assisted coding — your expert judgment directly improves the next generation of developer tools
* Spots are limited — the first cohort is small and starting soon

The team has shipped products that have grown from a handful of design partners to global enterprise rollouts, and the pipeline keeps growing.
  
  
We operate with a strong 0→1 mindset: ambiguity is the default, ownership is non-negotiable, and the patterns that the next decade of enterprise AI will be measured against are being prototyped on our team right now.
  
  
Responsibilities:
  
- End-to-end product engineering. Take ideas from prototype to production. One week you might be building the foundational services that power the product; the next, the user-facing surface or operator tooling; the week after, the instrumentation and feedback loops that tell you whether it worked.
  
- Enterprise features with real customer impact. Ship the capabilities enterprise customers evaluate, contract against, and renew on — features that have to meet a real-world quality bar, not a demo bar.
  
- Pair with ML on the frontier. Work side by side with our ML and inference teams to turn frontier model capability into something enterprise customers can rely on — predictable, isolated, audit-ready, and built for the kind of scale only a frontier AI product sees.

- BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with industry experience.

**Description**
Application deadline: Nov 9, 2026
  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Help us push the availability and reliability of cloud infrastructure to new heights! The AWS Data Center Systems team builds services to monitor and data center infrastructure controls monitoring and alerting systems. Our services directly contribute to the high availability of AWS data centers and Amazon’s sustainability goals. Teams in Data Center Systems solve problems of massive metric ingestion, distributed systems/cloud computing, data visualization, anomaly detection, analytics, and graph networks.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer who is passionate about leading the architecture and development of application software that helps keep Amazon data centers running efficiently and securely. On any given day, we use Python, Java, Go, Lambda, DynamoDB, and CloudFormation, as well as other public AWS services and a host of Amazon-internal tools.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
In this role, you'll design, develop, and maintain the software systems that power AWS data center infrastructure planning and tracking. You'll build scalable solutions that ensure accurate representation of physical infrastructure—from power and cooling to network connectivity—enabling teams across AWS to make informed capacity decisions. You'll collaborate with senior engineers on system architecture while mentoring junior team members. You'll own features end-to-end: gathering requirements, designing APIs and data models, implementing robust solutions, and driving operational excellence through monitoring, alarming, and on-call support. You'll work to improve data quality, reduce manual interventions in automated pipelines, and eliminate operational toil. You'll partner with cross-functional teams to integrate infrastructure data across planning, design, and deployment workflows. Above all, you'll care deeply about data integrity and system reliability, building solutions that scale with AWS's rapid growth while maintaining the accuracy our customers depend on.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Your morning might start with standup, sharing progress on a new alarm evaluation or device management feature, then a code review where you give thoughtful feedback to an SDE I. You spend a focused block writing service or stream-processing code, or CDK to wire up a new pipeline, then debug a production issue that surfaced overnight, finding the root cause and writing a permanent fix. After lunch you join a design review, asking the questions that surface unstated assumptions. You wrap up walking through alarm or tooling feedback with a data center operations or controls team, turning what you hear into the next improvement.

**Business Summary:**
The AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions that support intelligent automation, predictive insight, and advanced analytics across the enterprise. As a hands-on builder, this role applies software engineering principles to write production-quality code, build scalable AI systems, including AI Agents and data pipelines, and integrate AI models into new and existing business applications. The AI Engineer collaborates closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, ML Ops Engineers, and Platform teams to bring machine learning models from prototype to production. A critical part of this function is to ensure that AI use cases are transitioned from experimentation into reliable, governed, and business-ready solutions by owning their complete operational readiness. This includes implementing robust observability, defining Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and establishing clear incident response and rollback strategies for all AI services.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
Model Development & Implementation - Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code to develop and implement machine learning and AI models that support various business use cases. Implement data engineering and preprocessing workflows required for model inputs. Continuously optimize the performance and scalability of AI applications and models.
  
  
ML Pipelines & Operations (MLOps) - Design, develop, and maintain scalable ML pipelines for model training, validation, inference, and deployment. Collaborate with ML Ops Engineers to package and deploy models into enterprise systems using established MLOps practices. Monitor deployed models in production for performance, data drift, and reliability, and troubleshoot and resolve any issues that arise. Establish and own the operational readiness of all AI services by defining and implementing Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for key metrics, such as p50/p95 latency and availability, and creating robust monitoring and alerting for model drift, latency, and error rates.
  
  
Collaboration & Integration - Work closely with Data Scientists to transition experimental models and research prototypes into robust, production-ready systems. Support the integration of AI capabilities into enterprise workflows, applications, and digital platforms. Contribute to the documentation and explainability of model outputs to ensure clarity for business stakeholders.
  
  
Governance & Strategy - Ensure all deployed AI systems comply with enterprise governance, fairness, and security standards. Evaluate emerging AI technologies, such as LLMs and generative AI, to assess their applicability to business problems and drive innovation.
  
  
**Preferred Skills, Knowledge, And Experience**
**Core Technical & AI Proficiency -**
Strong coding skills in Python, Java, or C++, including API development and software design. Deep understanding of core machine learning concepts, including classification, regression, clustering, and deep learning architectures. Hands-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks and algorithms (supervised/unsupervised), such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar for building and training complex neural networks. Skills in working with LLMs, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and using frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph to build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems. Handling data wrangling, SQL, data warehousing, and ETL pipelines to prepare data for models.
  
  
**End-to-End ML Model Lifecycle -**
Proven experience in the end-to-end model lifecycle: developing, training, and deploying machine learning models from prototype to production. Mastery of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation techniques to ensure robust and accurate model performance. Demonstrated ability to build and optimize scalable data pipelines for training and evaluating machine learning models. Strong knowledge of both SQL and NoSQL databases for querying and managing data for AI applications.
  
  
**Software & MLOps Engineering -**
Solid foundation in software engineering best practices, including version control (Git), automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines. Hands-on experience with containerization using Docker and container orchestration with Kubernetes for scalable deployment. Expertise in MLOps observability, including model monitoring to track performance and drift, and establishing model/version lineage, telemetry, and traceability. Experience implementing advanced testing and deployment strategies, including canary/shadow deployments and comprehensive test suites (unit, integration, adversarial, regression). Demonstrated ability to integrate AI models and services into enterprise applications by building and consuming RESTful APIs.
  
  
**Cloud & Infrastructure -**
Proficiency with at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, Azure) and its associated AI/ML services (e.g., Vertex AI, SageMaker, Azure ML). Experience with big data technologies, such as Apache Spark or similar, for processing large-scale datasets in a cloud environment.
  
  
**Collaboration & Frontend Development -**
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an Agile development environment. Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience with modern frontend JavaScript frameworks such as React, Vue.js, Angular or similar for building user-facing applications that consume AI models.
  
  
**Minimum Education**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field is required; Master’s is highly preferred.
  
  
**Minimum Experience**
Must have independently built, trained, and iterated on multiple ML models. This includes 2+ years of hands-on experience with a deep learning framework.

**About Us**
Mintive helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools.
  
  
Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. Our gateway product scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.
  
  
We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.
  
  
We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.
  
  
Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.
  
  
****The Job****
You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it.
  
  
Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers.
  
  
We hire across levels, from strong early-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship.
  
  
**About You**

* You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals.
* You have strong fundamentals and learn fast. How quickly you pick things up matters as much as years of experience.
* You care about product value and customer needs over technical purity.
* You take infra seriously. You think about blast radius, trust boundaries, and what happens when your code is in the path of every customer's agents.
* You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs.
* You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast.
* You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem.
* You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process.

****Nice to have:****

* Developer-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale.
* Background in security, identity, or permission systems.
* Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks.
* Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure.

****What we offer:****

* Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.
* Unusual scope and ownership of features that ship to enterprise customers.
* Building and deploying agents on the same platform we sell.
* Direct access to the founders, customer context, and product direction, with mentorship as you grow.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

This is a production-focused effort built around practical outcomes, not experimental prototypes. The team is developing intelligent capabilities that can support thousands of public-facing forms and help people complete important tasks more quickly and accurately.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead the architecture and delivery of the platform’s AI capabilities. In this senior, hands-on role, you will build machine learning infrastructure, develop retrieval-augmented generation workflows, and help introduce fine-tuned language models and human feedback loops. You will collaborate with product, full-stack, and platform engineering teams to integrate intelligent features into a no-code form builder and ensure they perform reliably in production. This is an opportunity to shape the AI roadmap, make informed decisions about emerging model capabilities, and deliver solutions that serve real users. **WHY BOX NEEDS YOU**

We serve as the caching layer within our core relational data tier processing tens of millions of requests per second, while also powering numerous critical, high-throughput, and low-latency workflows. We've just closed fresh funding to scale this operating model to retail insurance agencies across the country.
  
Our CEO, Joey Bouchard, built and ran applied AI teams at Palantir. We bring that technical rigor together with years of hands-on insurance operations experience to help agencies deploy AI that works in the real world. (Why insurance is worth this attention.)
  
Why this role existsBrokerage execution runs on heroics. Service quality depends on who owns the account, how overloaded they are, and what they happen to remember at the right moment. A submission gets marketed broadly, or it doesn't. A renewal gets the same rigor as new business, or it doesn't. A missing detail gets chased, or it stalls.
  
We don't think that's inevitable. Brokerage execution can be made systematic: software, automation, and AI carrying disciplined follow-through alongside human experts, inside clear bounds, in a regulated environment.
  
The hard part isn't the model call. It's governability — making AI accountable enough to trust with real deal flow. Who is the AI acting for? What is it allowed to do? What happens when it's wrong? In a regulated industry, those aren't side questions. They're the engineering problem.We've been answering them inside our own wholesale brokerage for years. That's where we test whether the model actually produces more reliable, scalable, and consistent service. If it doesn't work for us, it doesn't deserve to be packaged for the market. **Internship - Machine Learning and image-based metrics for EUV system setup**

**Introduction**
ASML US, including its affiliates and subsidiaries, bring together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, Netherlands and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Chandler, Arizona, San Jose and San Diego, California, Wilton, Connecticut, and Hillsboro, Oregon.
  
  
**Your Assignment**
In ASML EUV Light Sources, high power lasers interact with Sn material to create the Plasma that generates EUV light. Achieving the correct alignment between the lasers and the Sn material is essential for efficient and stable operation. High-speed camera images captured during EUV formation contain valuable spatial information about this interaction. Your goal will be to develop image-based Key Performance Indicator (KPIs) that describe the alignment between lasers and Sn material. .
  
  
**Key Idea and Deliverables**
You will apply machine learning, and image analysis techniques to high-speed images collected during controlled experiments. The objective is to identify image characteristics that reliably indicate good laser-to-Sn alignment, and translate them into simple, measurable KPIs.
  
  
The project will involve:
  
  

* Collecting and organizing high-speed image data from controlled experiments
* Extract relevant image features using a mix of conventional image-processing techniques and/or explore ML/AI methods
* Develop one or more image-based KPIs that summarize the relevant information
* Validate the propose KPIs against performance measurements, and their robustness across different operating conditions

**Success Criteria**
Identification of image-based KPIs that show clear, repeatable trends with laser and Sn material alignment quality and demonstrate improved observability compared to current methodology in use on EUV sources. .
  
  
**Your Profile**

* Must be pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, control systems, physics, applied mathematics, or a related technical field.

Come build the future of data streaming with the Amazon Managed Streaming for Kafka (MSK) team!
  
  
We are seeking builders for our Amazon MSK service, a fully managed service that makes it easy for customers to build and run applications that use Apache Kafka to process streaming data. We are looking for engineers who are enthusiastic about data streaming, and are as passionate about contributing to open source as they are about solving real customers' business needs, at AWS scale.
  
  
As a member of the Amazon MSK team, you will be making contributions to the entire core data plane stack that make up the MSK service, the core Kafka platform, and stand-alone tools that make it easier for Kafka community to operate Kafka better. Upstream compatibility is a core tenet of MSK. Your code changes to the Kafka platform will be released back to open source. As a member of an AWS service that builds on top of a popular open source technology, this is a unique opportunity to work on a team that straddles both worlds – open source and Amazon-internal software. You will design and build new features, make performance improvements, identify and investigate new technologies, prototype solutions, build scalable services, and test and review changes, to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
  
  
The ideal candidate has experience designing large-scale systems supporting millions of transactions per second, enjoys solving complex software problems, and possesses analytical, design and problem-solving skills. Ideally you have an in-depth understanding of streaming data technologies like Amazon Kinesis or Apache Kafka, and experience with open-source data processing frameworks like Apache Spark, Apache Flink, or Apache Storm. Your responsibilities will include collaborating with other engineers to build a large scale AWS service, and work with senior leaders to define your team's roadmap, including identifying design and code changes needed in the underlying open source platforms.

**About Ascent**
Ascent Developer Solutions is a leading private lending platform, serving real estate developers nationwide in the acquisition, renovation, and construction of residential real estate. Founded by a leadership team with a deep understanding and personal experience in virtually every facet of real estate development, Ascent is uniquely positioned to create custom, innovative lending solutions for a variety of real estate development business strategies.
  
  
**The Role:**
Ascent Developer Solutions is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to build software for the most complex workflows in real estate lending. You'll embed with the business teams who run those workflows, learn them in detail, and build AI-powered tools alongside them that scale their expertise as we grow. This is an engineering role first: you'll write production code, take it through security review, and support it after launch. You'll report directly to the Head of Technology, and your scope will grow with every project you deliver.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES:**

* Embed with an assigned business team and learn the work by doing it alongside them.
* Document workflows step by step – inputs, systems, decisions, handoffs, and exceptions – including what happens upstream and downstream, in a standard format the team reviews and signs off on.
* Build and ship production automations for well-defined workflows.
* Work with Platform Engineering so each automation runs on the existing platform – shared data, integrations, and monitoring – and fits the systems already in place rather than standing alone.
* Write clear specifications and acceptance criteria for work that belongs in the core lending platform, and hand them to Platform Engineering.
* Write tests and documentation for each automation, and take it through code review and the security and AI governance gate before it reaches production.
* Build with least-privilege agent identities, audit logging, and human review for any output that affects a loan decision or a disbursement of funds.
* Measure time and error rates before and after each automation, and report the results.
* Train users on new automations, gather feedback, and fix issues quickly after launch.
* Monitor shipped automations, respond to failures, and maintain runbooks so the business team knows how to handle exceptions.

**GENERAL DUTIES:**

* Learn the lending business, from application through payoff, well enough to spot automation opportunities others miss.
* Bring automation ideas to the Forward Deployed Engineer II and the Head of Technology with a rough estimate of hours saved.
* Partner with Data & Analytics on data definitions and data-quality issues found in the field.
* Contribute reusable components to shared libraries.
* Follow engineering standards, including version control, code review, automated testing, and change management.
* Protect borrower data in line with company security policies and the AI Use Policy, and raise risks early.
* Keep workflow maps, specifications, runbooks, and change logs current.
* Provide regular status updates to department leaders and the Head of Technology.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 1–3 years of professional experience writing code that real users relied on – in software engineering, automation, data engineering, or a technical analyst role with substantial coding.
* Working proficiency in Python or TypeScript and SQL, plus experience with REST APIs and unstructured data.
* Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs – prompting, structured outputs, and document extraction – in professional or personal projects.
* Daily use of AI coding tools, with the habit of verifying their output with tests.
* Familiarity with loop engineering – agent workflows that act, check their own results, and stop or escalate to a person at the right point.
* Asks good questions before building, and can explain a technical idea to a non-technical colleague.
* Thinks in systems: considers how a change in one workflow affects the data, systems, and people around it.
* Organized, detail-oriented writer – workflow maps and specifications are deliverables in this role, not afterthoughts.
* Interest in financial services; exposure to lending, real estate, construction, or accounting a plus.
* Experience with OutSystems or another low-code platform, Microsoft 365/SharePoint, or Jira a plus.
* Portfolio, GitHub profile, or other examples of shipped work strongly preferred.

Salary range is $90,000 to $105,000, with a discretionary bonus of 15% per year
